steps.npc: Hello mortal. What do you seek?

options.text: What changes have been made for this League?

steps.player: What changes have been made for this League?

steps.npc: Much has changed since the world was shattered. This time, I thought I'd turn the clock back and allow you to Trailblaze once more.
As before, you'll initially be restricted to the Regions of Misthalin and Karamja. However, as you progress, you'll be able to unlock new areas of your choosing.
Be warned though - you won't be able to unlock every area, so choose wisely.
You must participate as an Iron Man. This means you stand alone and cannot trade with other participants.
And that's not all. Training skills during the League will grant you substantially more experience than you'd normally expect.
These experience increases are known as passive effects, which get more generous the higher your Relic tier.
Finally, some quests have been completed for you automatically. Further quests and more will be completed as you unlock the relevant areas.
I think that covers the basics. Would you like to know more, [player name]?
Is there anything else you need from me?
In every League, there are a number of tasks for you to complete. Each task has a level of difficulty: Easy, Medium, Hard, Elite and Master.
Completing tasks allows you to access new areas. The more tasks you complete, the more areas become available to unlock.
Not only that, completing tasks also earns you League Points. The number of points earned is dependent on the difficulty of the task.
Once you have achieved a certain amount of League Points you can unlock a new Relic of mine. These are powerful artefacts to help you in this world.
League Points can also be used to buy rewards from the Leagues Reward Shop.

steps.text: As we speak, you are playing on your Leagues profile. The Leagues Reward Shop can only be opened on your main profile.
You can access your main profile by switching to any normal Old School RuneScape world. The world switcher in the logout menu can be used to switch worlds.

steps.player: So how many tasks are there?

steps.npc: More than you'll ever be able to complete, most likely. It's up to you which ones you attempt.
Now, would you like to take a look at the tasks for this League?
Is there anything else you need from me?

options.text: How does the area system work?

steps.player: How does the area system work?

steps.npc: Currently, you are restricted to the Kingdom of Misthalin and the island of Karamja. However, as you progress, you can unlock more areas.
There are ten different areas in total. However, you can only unlock a maximum of five, including the two you've started with. Choose wisely.
I give the first two area unlocks to everyone. You can unlock the other three by completing the tasks I've set.
The more tasks you complete, the more areas you can unlock.
Would you like to take a look at the available areas now?
Is there anything else you need from me?
Relics are powerful artefacts made by me that grant unique abilities for the entire League.
You may even recognise a few from Leagues past.
The first Relic tier is available to everyone. The others must be unlocked with League Points.
Once you have selected a Relic, your choice can't be changed for the rest of the League. Make your choices carefully.
Is there anything else you need from me?

options.text: Can I claim some Combat rewards?

steps.text: If the player has not completed any Combat Achievements tiers:

steps.npc: You do not appear to have any combat achievement rewards available to claim.

steps.text: If the player has completed any Combat Achievements tiers:

steps.player: Can I claim some combat achievement rewards?

steps.npc: Oh, how have you been getting on?

steps.player: I've completed some more Combat Achievement tasks!

steps.npc: I can see that. Nice job. You'll be expecting your medium rewards?

There you go. I've provided you with one of our more modest ancient sword hilts. You'll also have an easier time obtaining medium clues, increased max quantities offered when given boss Slayer tasks, bonus tokens

from the Warrior guild and two extra commendation points from each Pest Control game. Additionally, equipping one of my sword hilts at the Barrows will prevent your prayer points from being drained and
your Dwarf multicannon can hold five extra cannonballs.

steps.player: Can I claim any league trophies I may of earned from this league?

steps.text: Claiming trophies is temporarily disabled, please try again later.

steps.npc: As well as letting you unlock new areas, completing tasks in the League will earn you League Points. The more League Points you have, the more Relic tiers you have available.
However, alongside allowing you to unlock Relics, League Points can also be used to buy rewards from the Leagues Reward Shop.
Oh, all sorts of things. New cosmetic kits, an alternative Home Teleport animation, some rather stylish outfits... and much more.
Many of these rewards can be traded with your fellow mortals, so if you wish, you can earn some money by selling them on. Of course, you might prefer to keep them for yourself instead.

steps.player: I see. That all sounds good to me.

steps.text: Currently, you are playing on your Leagues profile. The Leagues Reward Shop can only be used to buy items on your main profile, although you can still browse the shop within the League.

steps.npc: Would you like to look at the rewards shop?

steps.text: You can access your main profile by switching to any normal Old School RuneScape world. The world switcher in the logout menu can be used to switch worlds.

steps.npc: You can use this shop to buy previous League rewards, too.
Alongside the rewards in the Leagues Reward Shop, there's also League Ranks.

steps.player: League Ranks? How do they work?

steps.npc: During the League as you gain more points you will gain a League Rank. This rank can be seen in the Ranks interface.
You currently have the rank: Unranked.
As you get ranks you will gain access to trophies.
That's right. Trophies are items that are awarded to you for competing in the League. You can use them to show off your League Rank.
Connected to League Ranks are the League to League rewards. These are unlocked in the next League based upon the League Rank you earn in this one.
League Starter Outfits and League Icons are some of things you can unlock for the next League. In addition, any pets you earn in this League will transfer over to the next one.
Finally, on top of the tasks for this League, there are some other activities for which I will recognise the first person who completes them.
You can view the entire list of activities, as well as whether or not someone has completed them, by reading the board beside me.
My pleasure. Now, is there anything else you need from me?

steps.player: Can you tell me how pets work in Leagues?

steps.npc: But of course. If you're lucky enough to obtain a pet during a League, it will automatically be insured for you.
This means that if you lose it somehow you can talk to me and I'll give it back to you. Insurance and reclaiming is all free of charge.
Additionally, each pet you obtain will be transferred to the next League. I'll take good care of it until you're ready to reclaim it.
Come back to me once you have some pets and you can view your collection. Now, is there anything else you need from me?

options.text: Do I have any League items to collect?

steps.text: If the player has insufficient inventory space:

steps.npc: I can give you [number] League [item/items] once you free up some space in your inventory.

steps.text: You receive some items from the Sage.

options.text: Can you help me smash vials?

steps.text: If the player does not have smashing vials enabled:

steps.player: Can you help me smash vials?

steps.npc: With all of my power, this is something I can manage. You will now automatically smash vials.

steps.text: If the player does have smashing vials enabled:

steps.player: Can you help me smash vials?

steps.npc: With all of my power, this is something I can manage. You will no longer smash vials automatically.
Very well. I'll be here if you ever need to know anything more.
